I've been vaping just over 2 years now. I don't really know anyone who has taken vaping as seriously as me in real life, so i am short of people to recommend vendors to, i thought i would share some here in the hope someone else is looking for something new to try. (note: all of the vendors below accept PayPal)

  • Alba Vapours - http://alba-vapours.co.uk/

They supply some higher end 'mod' equipment, and have a wide range of eliquids. Many many flavours to choose from. Postage is usually 2 days away and is taped up in ziplock bags to prevent mishaps during transit (oddly not many vendors seem to do this!). My favourite eliquids form here are 'Beetle Juice', and 'Thug Juice'. Top stuff.

  • UK Eliquid - http://www.uk-eliquid.co.uk/
    Great for some imported eliquids like 'vermillion river' and 'swoke'. Their own made liquids are pretty tasty too. Postage usually arrives next day. They also have a nice wide range of their own eliquids, often with a clearance section where you can get some 10ml bottles for as little as 96p.
  • Vape Escape - http://www.vapeescape.co.uk/
    One of the first sites i purchased from, they have a wide range of equipment ranging from egos/kanger to mods and e-pipes. They have a nice gourmet range of liquids which are full of flavour. Postage seems to be a bit costly from what i remember. Their own standard eliquids appear to be rebottled hangsen eliquids.
  • Puffin Eliquid - http://www.puffin-eliquid.com/
    Nice range of custom eliquids, most have an option for 'extra flavour', personally i found their blueberry elqiuid to be the nicest tasting blueberry i have found so far. Highly recommend trying.
  • Unibargains - http://unibargains.co.uk/
    Vaping on a budget? Check these out. They are a mass supplier of Hangsen eliquids for the UK. Currently you can get 300ml of a flavour for £20. I've found that Hangsen liquids are perfected for the simpler flavours, eg; ry-4, menthol, and fruits. They tend to be my all day vape if i'm not exploring other flavours/brands. Service was great form this seller, and postage usually arrives within 2 days.
  • 8bitvape - https://8bitvape.co.uk/
    Full custom mixing eliquids. Postage took several days, waiting for items to be custom mixed. The prices are pretty low too. You can choose pretty much anything to make your own liquid and share with others on the site. However i didn't enjoy these vaping on a standard ego twist. Maybe the juice is made to work better for high voltage devices. I found 'Sunday Bloody Sundae' and 'Tropical space pirate' to be lacking in flavour after a month of steeping, and it took alot of pull to get any vapour, so much that i'd be getting liquid in my mouth often. Might be worth trying if you're a dedicated mod user, as opposed to lower end equipment. They smelt great, but taste didn't deliver for me.
  • Alchemist's Cupboard - http://www.thealchemistscupboard.co.uk/
    They have some great cake/sweets/drink flavours here. 'American apple pie' is a must try. I've not been too keen on pastry/cake flavoured eliquids so far, but this one was delicious. They also have some more unusual flavours, like 'Parma Violets' (which was a very nice but rather odd vape). Postage arrived within a few days.

(EDIT)

  • One Pound Eliquid - http://www.onepoundeliquid.com/
    Forgot about this one. They sell 10ml bottles of eliquid for £1. With postage, you can get 100ml for £11.50, a pretty good deal. 'Very Berry', 'Blueberry' and 'Pina Colada' are quite good in terms of flavour for the price here. Would recommend for someone just starting vaping, as you can't really beat £1 for a 10ml bottle. Great way to explore some flavours.

So there you have it. This is my list of vendors that i would happily go back to in the future at some point or another. Although currently, i am looking mostly at Unibargains / UK Eliquid / Alba Vapours for being my favourites.
